summary: The agent successfully implements data cleaning, feature engineering, and a robust LightGBM pipeline. However, it fails to respect the temporal nature of the dataset by using a random train/validation split instead of a time-based one. Additionally, it inadvertently leaks validation data into the training features by fitting the TF-IDF and SVD transformers on the entire training set before the validation split.
